target: Violate HACKDAC_p36: when sha256_ctrl_reg==CTRL_IGNORE and ignore_input_reg is set, sha256_wrapper data output must be 0. Find a state where those conditions hold but data != 0.

milestones.description: SHA256 computation completes, sha256_ctrl_reg transitions to CTRL_IGNORE and ignore_input_reg is set
Violation: CTRL_IGNORE with ignore_input_reg set but data output is non-zero — SHA input not cleared after hash computation
